summary: Round r1 (restricted network). Q1 (latest IMF-WB DSA risk of debt distress) and Q2 (how concessional terms change with IDA/ADF graduation) are pending. The latest DSA vintage located is the joint LIC DSA in the 2026 Article IV / seventh (final) ECF review staff report, completed by the IMF Board in June 2026 (eLibrary and country-report page leads); the rating must be read from that annex and is not asserted here. Graduation rules located: IDA21 Terms effective July 2026, IDA Financial Products Overview (April 2026, FY2027 operational cutoff), IDA20 mid-term review on graduation prospects, IDA18 graduation-policy review, IDA borrowing-country list; ADB Concessional Assistance Policy for ADF 14 (2025-2028), ADB allocation and lending-rates pages, Operations Manual A1. PDMO bulletin/MTDS and IDS supply current terms. Method: map Nepal's category and GNI-per-capita distance to cutoffs, then compute grant elements of each term set as conditional paths.

findings.claim: Q1: Nepal's external and overall risk of debt distress in the latest joint IMF-World Bank LIC DSA, with debt-carrying capacity classification and vintage.
findings.note: Latest located vintage: DSA annex of the 2026 Article IV / seventh ECF review staff report (Board completion June 2026). Record the ratings verbatim with the document date; compare with the sixth-review (2025) vintage. Press-release snippets did not state the rating; no rating is asserted here.
findings.period: DSA vintage 2026 (projections on Nepal FY basis)

findings.claim: Q1: DSA thresholds, baseline debt burden indicators and the most extreme stress-test breach.
findings.note: DSA annex tables (external PPG debt PV/GDP, PV/exports, debt service/exports, debt service/revenue; total public debt PV/GDP).

findings.claim: Q2: Nepal's current IDA category (IDA-only, gap or blend) and ADB group (A, B or C), dated.
findings.note: IDA Borrowing Countries page (current FY) and ADB classification page; record with retrieval date.

findings.claim: Q2: IDA operational cutoff (World Bank FY2027) versus Nepal's GNI per capita (Atlas), and years above/below cutoff.
findings.note: IDA Financial Products Overview (April 2026) and IDA21 Terms; Nepal GNI per capita Atlas from WDI (NY.GNP.PCAP.CD).

findings.claim: Q2: IDA terms by category (regular, blend, gap; grant share by DSA risk) and ADB ADF 14 grant/COL terms; concessionality (grant element) of each.
findings.note: IDA21 Terms effective July 2026; ADB CAP ADF 14 policy paper and lending-rates page. Grant element computed with IMF/WB discount rate convention (estimate method).

findings.claim: Q2: Average terms (interest, maturity, grace, grant element) of Nepal's new external commitments and outstanding debt.
findings.note: PDMO debt bulletin and MTDS; IDS average terms of new commitments (calendar year).

findings.claim: Graduation mechanics (from policy documents, to be verified on retrieval): IDA graduation requires both income above the operational cutoff for a sustained period and IBRD creditworthiness, typically passing through gap/blend terms; ADB reclassification from group A to B depends on GNI per capita and creditworthiness. Hardening of terms is therefore gradual and conditional; LDC graduation (UN) does not itself change IDA or ADB eligibility.
findings.note: Policy-design statement; exact criteria and transition periods to be taken from the IDA21 and ADF 14 documents.

findings.claim: Concessionality outlook scenarios will be expressed as term paths (share of new borrowing on IDA-regular, blend, ADB COL, OCR, bilateral/commercial) conditional on stated GNI-per-capita paths, not as forecasts of graduation dates.

data_gaps: The DSA annex tables must be retrieved from the staff report; the press releases do not carry the rating.
Current ADB group classification for Nepal needs a dated ADB document (country partnership strategy or ADF allocation list); not yet located as a direct file.
Bilateral creditor terms (JICA, EXIM China, EXIM India lines of credit) are not covered by the leads; PDMO creditor tables are the planned source.
IDA21 country allocation for Nepal (performance-based allocation) not located.
The session web-search budget was exhausted before all planned searches ran; some leads below were reused from 16A/16B and some document-level leads remain unlocated (listed individually).
No lead URL was downloaded in r1 (data hosts blocked); all values await `python -m src.cli leads --fetch`, extraction and ingest in r2.

assumptions.text: The DSA used is the most recent published joint IMF-WB LIC DSA at retrieval; if a newer World Bank-only or IMF vintage appears, both are kept with dates.
Grant element is computed with the discount-rate convention stated in the IMF/WB debt-limits policy in force at retrieval; the convention is recorded with each estimate.
LDC graduation is treated as institutionally separate from IDA/ADB eligibility; any indirect effects (e.g. on donor grant allocations) are flagged for 26A, not assumed.

challenges.text: Conflict C-08/C-09: DSA debt coverage (public and publicly guaranteed, general government) differs from PDMO central-government debt; the DSA ratios cannot be compared with PDMO-based ratios without a coverage bridge.
X22 lists 20C and 26A as joint primary suppliers; propose 20C supplies DSA ratings and terms, 26A supplies donor/creditor relations, to avoid duplicate observations.
Escalation: if the retrieved DSA rating or a reclassification of Nepal's IDA/ADB status differs from what S04/S08/S10 assume, the scenario financing assumptions must be re-audited.

uncertainty: High. No rating, cutoff or term has been retrieved. DSA ratings depend on the vintage and on the debt-carrying-capacity classification, which can change between reviews. Graduation timing depends on GNI-per-capita (Atlas, calendar year) paths and creditworthiness judgments that are not rule-based.

dsa_status.method: Read DSA annex verbatim; record ratings as dated facts (observations) with page/table references; record breaches by indicator; note coverage of public debt used.
dsa_status.fiscal_year_note: DSA projections are on Nepal FY; IDS stocks are calendar year-end.

items: IDA operational cutoff FY2027 (GNI per capita, Atlas)
IDA gap/blend rules and IBRD creditworthiness
IDA grant eligibility by DSA risk
ADB group A/B/C criteria and graduation policy
ADF 14 grant eligibility by DSA risk

concessionality_outlook.transition_path_design: Conditional term paths: for each GNI-per-capita path supplied by 03 (in USD, Atlas, calendar), determine years above IDA cutoff and ADB thresholds, apply gap/blend/graduation rules from the documents, and compute the weighted average grant element and interest cost of new borrowing. Output is conditional, not a graduation forecast.
concessionality_outlook.gni_distance_to_cutoff: pending (requires WDI NY.GNP.PCAP.CD for Nepal and the FY2027 cutoff)
